title: Smooth Camera Lerp
description: Add lerp_speed to Camera for smooth target following.
notes: Add lerp_speed to GSDL::Camera to support smooth frame-by-frame target following (lerping).

title: GSDL Core Foundation
description: Foundation mandates for the GSDL engine core architecture.
notes: Foundation mandates for the GSDL engine core architecture. This epic covers the established, stable systems that form the GSDL framework.

title: Core Structure
notes:
• Game owns the main loop, window, and global Draw instance.
• Manages a stack of Scene objects (@scenes : Array(Scene)).
• Execution Context: Game uses an internal @execution_stack to track which scene is currently processing (update/draw). Game.camera automatically resolves to the correct camera based on this context.
• Entity System: Scene and Entity support a parent-child hierarchy via add_child. Updates and draws are automatically propagated through the hierarchy.
• Supports push, pop, replace, and switch for scene transitions.

title: Asset & Data Management
notes:
• AssetManager: Handles loading of assets (textures, audio, fonts, tilemaps, dialogs). Supports 'Loose' assets in debug and 'Packed' assets in release.
• GSDL::Loadable: Unified load_assets pattern for Game and Scene.
• Per-Scene Loading: Scenes can override load_textures, load_audio, etc., for sync or async loading.
• GSDL::Data: JSON-centric key-value store for game state (scores, flags). Supports deep nesting and simple save/load persistence.

title: Rendering & Drawing
description: Z-layered commands, vertex batching, and logical presentation.
notes:
• Command-based drawing system (DrawCommand) with z-indexing, culling, and camera-relative positioning.
• Optimization (Layered Buffer): Commands stored in Z-index buckets (@layers) to avoid heavy sorting.
• Depth Sorting: Within Z-layers, sorted by Y-position using a non-allocating sort! block.
• Vertex Batching: Implement SDL_RenderGeometry to minimize draw calls for shared textures.
• Two-Pass Tinting: Separate buffers for base textures and color-tinted overlays.
• Logical Resolution: Decouples game resolution (e.g., 320x240) from window resolution (e.g., 1080p).
• Scaling: Handled via SDL_SetRenderLogicalPresentation (Letterbox, Stretch, etc.).
• Visual Offsets: GSDL::SpriteBase separates physical base (draw_y) from visual rendering position (render_offset_y) to support height/depth effects without breaking Y-sorting.

title: TileMap System
notes:
• Supports Tiled .json and .tmx formats.
• Multi-Layer & Object Support: TileLayer and ObjectGroup layers.
• Tileset Management: GSDL::Tileset handles textures and solid_tiles collision metadata.
• Tile Objects: GSDL::TileObject and TileObjectFactory handle rectangles, ellipses, points, and custom tiled objects.

title: Collision System
description: AABB, Circle, and SAT support via Collidable.
notes:
• Custom collision system supporting AABB (Rect), Circle, and SAT (Polygon) checks via GSDL::Collidable.
• GSDL::CollisionSpace: Manages a flat list of Collidable entities (usually via GSDL::SceneCollisions).

title: UI & RichText
notes:
• FontManager & DialogManager (YAML-based structured dialogue).
• UI Components: Button, ProgressBar, Slider, TabContainer, TextInput, ScrollTextView.
• RichText: Inline colored/styled text with texture baking strategy.
• RichTextTyped: Typewriter-style reveals for rich text.
• HUD: Screen-space overlays with anchoring and padding support.

title: Input & Tweens
description: Action mapping, MultiTapTracker, and Tweenable presets.
notes:
• Input: GSDL::Input and GSDL::Keys with action-based mapping.
• MultiTapTracker: Handles double/triple tap detection.
• Animation: GSDL::Animation and AnimationPlayer for frame-based sprites.
• Particles: GSDL::ParticleEmitter and GSDL::Particle for VFX.
• Movement Controllers: GSDL::TopDownController, PlatformerController, PhysicsController, and VerticalScrollController.
• Tweens: GSDL::Tweenable for transitions (x, y, scale, color, tint) with presets (flash, shake, pulse, spin).

title: Camera System
description: View transformation, modes, and screen shake.
notes:
• View transformation (x, y, zoom).
• Modes: Fixed, AutoScroll, CenterOnTarget (with/without boundary), and Manual.
• Built-in screen shake via Tweenable integration.

title: Distribution & Packaging
notes:
• gsdl-packer: Standalone tool to bundle assets into assets.pack binary.
• release packaging: Automated bundle creation for macOS (.app), Windows (.exe + DLLs), and Linux (.tar.gz).

title: Spatial Querying
description: Implement spatial partitioning for CollisionSpace optimization.
notes: Implement spatial querying/partitioning in CollisionSpace to filter candidates for MoveController narrow-phase checks. Essential for performance in scenes with high entity counts.

title: SDF Font Support by Default
description: Enable Signed Distance Field (SDF) rendering by default for all fonts loaded via GSDL to ensure high-fidelity text at any scale.
notes: • Update GSDL::FontManager#load and GSDL::FontManager#load_from_memory in src/gsdl/ui/font_manager.cr.\n• Force sdf = true on the loaded font instance immediately after creation.

title: Unify Rotatable Text in TextBase
description: Refactor the text system to support rotation directly within GSDL::TextBase and its children, rendering GSDL::TextRotated obsolete. This leverages SDF font properties and the SDL_RenderTextureRotated API to ensure text remains sharp and smooth when rotated. NOTE: SDL_RenderTextureRotated must be implemented in sdl3.cr bindings first.

title: Binary Persistence
description: Implement obfuscated/binary save file format for game state.
notes: A requirement for a 'standard video game save file' that is harder to edit by users. Focuses on binary or obfuscated formats (e.g., Base64 or XOR) for local filesystem storage.

title: Enhanced Renderer Configuration
description: Optimize SDL_Renderer for GSDL's 'Standard Indie' aesthetic, ensuring pixel-perfect sprites, integer scaling, and VSync synchronization.
notes: • Modify GSDL::Game#_init in src/gsdl/core/game.cr to use SDL_LOGICAL_PRESENTATION_INTEGER_SCALE for logical presentation.\n• Update GSDL::Draw#initialize in src/gsdl/gfx/draw.cr to set the default scale quality to 'nearest' (0) via SDL_SetRenderScaleQuality.\n• Ensure GSDL::Game#vsync is correctly applied to the renderer in GSDL::Game#initialize.
